primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 歴代誌上2:1は、イスラエルの子らの名簿にシメオンを挙げます。歴代誌上4:24では、シメオンの子らとして複数の名が続きます。
primaryTextRead.text: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 「sons of Simeon」はシメオン個人ではなく子孫・集団を指す。個人シメオンのカードには結び付けず、別の集団文脈案として保留。
primaryTextRead.text: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 「sons of Simeon」は遠征する五百人の集団を指し、祖先個人ではない。集団用法の別文脈案として保留。
primaryTextRead.text: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 「tribe of the children of Simeon」は部族集団を指す。個人シメオンへ結び付けず保留。
primaryTextRead.text: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 「children of Simeon」は戦闘員の集団を指す。個人シメオンへ結び付けず保留。
primaryTextRead.text: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war: seven thousand one hundred.
